bill.title: An Act to expand the doula workforce

posted_text:
👩‍⚕️ MA H5021 — Massachusetts Creates Fund to Boost Doula Workforce

Massachusetts is launching a new Maternal Health Justice Fund to expand the doula workforce by providing scholarships to aspiring doulas and supporting existing programs, with a focus on prioritizing historically marginalized communities…

July 9, 2026: Reporting date extended to Thursday, December 31, 2026.
